info.title: Stampp API
info.description: Workspace-scoped work-time API. Authenticate with a Better Auth session cookie or a personal access token (Authorization: Bearer stpp_…). Product routes live under /api/v1. Mutations accept an optional Idempotency-Key header; all /api/v1 calls are rate limited per credential.

sessionCookie.name: better-auth.session_token
sessionCookie.description: Better Auth session cookie. Obtain via /api/auth/*.

personalAccessToken.description: Workspace-scoped personal access token. Send Authorization: Bearer stpp_… (created under workspace tokens).

kioskDeviceKey.name: x-kiosk-device-key
kioskDeviceKey.description: Registered kiosk device key returned once at device registration. Combined with member PIN or QR for attendance punches.

scimToken.description: Workspace SCIM token minted in settings.

Unauthenticated.description: Missing or invalid session or personal access token

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but not permitted in this workspace

NotFound.description: Resource not found or not visible in this workspace

Conflict.description: Unique constraint, illegal state transition, or Idempotency-Key conflict (payload mismatch or concurrent use of the same key).

RateLimited.description: Per-credential rate limit exceeded. Honor Retry-After.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the rate-limit window resets

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix seconds when the window resets
